summary: Frontend-only testing of new Wholesale Ordering system and Retail Product Image Notice. All 14 requested test cases passed. Old testids (wholesale-quote-btn-, wholesale-whatsapp-btn-, wholesale-copy-btn-) are fully removed. New wholesale-order-btn-* opens a fully working dialog with presets, custom qty +/-, min-15 validation, live estimated total, and Proceed to WhatsApp. wholesale-retail-btn-* is a correct wa.me anchor with retail enquiry message. Product Image Notice appears only on /products/:id (not on /wholesale). Mobile bottom-sheet with handle bar renders at 375x812.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration warning: a <span> instrumentation wrapper is being rendered as a child of <option> inside the SORT_OPTIONS select. Not caused by this iteration but visible in console. Consider rendering plain text in <option> or suppressing the dev-instrumentation wrapper for option children.

critical_code_review_comments: WholesaleOrderDialog.jsx handles product=null cleanly, prevents body scroll, and correctly resets on close via product prop. Good.
Custom qty input allows 1..14 which correctly triggers min warning + disables Proceed. Good.
Estimated total uses toLocaleString('en-IN') — matches ₹ formatting used elsewhere.

Minor: WholesaleOrderDialog does not reset mode/customQty when product changes; if user closes and reopens for a different product, previous selections persist. Consider useEffect resetting mode=20, customQty=50 when product changes. Not a blocker.
Minor: Backdrop close and Escape key — backdrop click works; Escape key not bound. Optional enhancement.
Pre-existing: dev-instrumentation wrapper injects <span> inside <option> causing hydration warning (unrelated to this task).
